component.name: Black Hole Screensaver
component.summary: Real-time GPU-rendered Gargantua black hole for your Linux desktop

description.p: A native OpenGL black-hole screensaver that does not play a looping video: every frame is computed live on your GPU from real physical parameters of a Schwarzschild black hole.

ul.li: Gravitational lensing of the background star field computed by geodesic integration.
An accretion disk with relativistic beaming and Doppler / gravitational redshift.
Works on X11 and Wayland (via GTK3).
DE-independent: a small daemon listens to the standard FreeDesktop / KDE / Cinnamon / GNOME / MATE screen-saver signals and launches full-screen on lock or idle, exiting on any input.

screenshot.caption: Full-screen gravitational-lensing visualization with accretion disk.
The black hole over a star field with relativistic beaming.

description.p: First public release: real-physics OpenGL black hole, DE-independent daemon, X11 + Wayland support, one-command install.
